Class AbstractContext<T>

java.lang.Object
io.github.mcalgovisualizations.visualization.models.AbstractContext<T>
Type Parameters:
T - the type of data stored by this context
All Implemented Interfaces:
AlgorithmContext<T>
public abstract class AbstractContext<T> extends Object implements AlgorithmContext<T>
Base implementation of AlgorithmContext.

This class stores the algorithm data and collects emitted IAlgorithmEvents in insertion order.

getEvents() returns a defensive copy, so callers cannot mutate the internal event history directly.
